GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is selected when a healthcare professional needs to track or analyze patient health metrics over a specific period.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves summarizing medication details, use industries_hls_einstein__SummarizePatientMedications.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only track and analyze patient health data. This includes summarizing medication details and monitoring health metrics. You aren't able to manage appointments or care plans.
